section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential
title: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Differential

content.description: Illustration showing SST (Special Service Tool) being used on a differential component with a washer thickness measurement setup

content.text: If the teeth are not contacting properly, use the following chart to select a proper washer for correction.

content.description: Illustration of rear differential assembly showing location where new spacer is to be installed

items: REMOVE COMPANION FLANGE (See step 10 on page RA-24)
REMOVE FRONT BEARING AND BEARING SPACER (See step 12 on page RA-25)
INSTALL NEW BEARING SPACER AND FRONT BEARING
(a) Install a new bearing spacer on the shaft.
(b) Install the front bearing on the shaft.

content.description: Detailed illustration showing SST tool being used to install oil slinger and oil seal on shaft

items: INSTALL OIL SLINGER AND NEW OIL SEAL
(a) Install the oil slinger facing as shown.
(b) Using SST, drive in a new oil seal.

content.text: Oil seal drive in depth: 1.5 mm (0.059 in.)
(c) Apply MP grease to the oil seal lip.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of companion flange using SST tool with Hold position indicated

items: (a) Using SST, install the companion flange on the shaft.

content.description: Illustration showing tightening of companion flange nut using SST tool

items: (b) Coat the threads of a new nut with MP grease.
(c) Using SST to hold the flange, tighten the nut.
